rows.quote: Subsequently, we performed one-sample Mendelian randomization (MR) using individual-level genomic data from the UK Biobank and pQTL summary statistics from the UKB-PPP, applying a two-stage least squares approach.
rows.coder_note: Step 3 (rule C): the authors' own analysis of UK Biobank individual-level data, defined by a described procedure and no participant number (one-sample MR by two-stage least squares on individual-level genomic data; Cox models for CKD in participants with abnormal glucose metabolism). The 'CKD GWAS summary statistics derived from the UK Biobank' of the two-sample MR are given by name alone and identify no release. No accession.
Step 4 (rule D): 'pQTL summary statistics from the UKB-PPP' by name alone; no cohort, ancestry, N, citation or accession separates the UKB-PPP rows. No accession.
Step 4 (rule D): 'pQTL data from deCODE' by name alone; no N, year, citation or accession separates the two deCODE rows. No accession.
